scope: Local execution extensions; deployed interpretation contracts remain unchanged

PAUSE_GENERATION.purpose: Request a cooperative durable generation pause

RESUME_GENERATION.purpose: Resume the same paused/interrupted generation job

RETRY_GENERATION.purpose: Explicitly retry unfinished saved academic work

RECOVERABLE_JOBS.purpose: Inspect paused or interrupted generation jobs

OPEN_HISTORY.purpose: Open the existing exam version history

EXPORT_DOCUMENT.purpose: Use the existing approved student Word/Markdown export

PAUSE_GENERATION.meaning: Pause generation while preserving valid work

RESUME_GENERATION.meaning: Continue unfinished generation from saved outputs

RETRY_GENERATION.meaning: Retry incomplete work after a recoverable failure

RECOVERABLE_JOBS.meaning: List jobs whose valid work may be continued

EXPORT_DOCUMENT.meaning: Download an approved Word or Markdown student document
